title: MemoryIndexRebuildResult
description: Result of dropping a tenant's derived retrieval index. Conversation truth and the memory assets themselves are untouched; without reembed the vectors are recomputed lazily by subsequent retrievals (a model-backed embedder only embeds a few per retrieval).

reembed.description: Present when the request asked for reembed=true: the recallable corpus was embedded with the active embedder before the reply.

embedder.description: Name of the embedder that wrote the vectors.

fingerprint.description: Vector space the vectors are cached under.

failed.description: Docs the embedder had no vector for; they stay BM25-only until a later re-embed.
